verdict.rationale: Folk is a CRM SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only a REST API, webhooks, an llms.txt file and an official MCP server. These are adjacent developer surfaces, and none of them is a first-party command-line tool, so the story gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
